label.en: ● The 4 Essential Forms of a Quadratic Function — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide
label.ar: ● The 4 Essential Forms of a Quadratic الدالة — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide

body.en:
Every quadratic parabola \(y = f(x)\) with leading coefficient \(a \neq 0\) (\(a > 0\) opens upward \(\cup\); \(a < 0\) opens downward \(\cap\)) can be expressed in four powerful SAT forms. Each form displays a different pair of symmetric anchor points directly in its constants:

Quadratic FormWhat Constants Reveal DirectlyAxis of SymmetryVertex \((x_v, y_v)\)\(y\)-InterceptHow to Quickly Graph (Step-by-Step)
1. Standard Form
\(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\)		\(y\)-intercept \((0, c)\) and symmetric partner \(\left(-\dfrac{b}{a},\; c\right)\) at height \(y = c\).\(x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}\)\(\left(-\dfrac{b}{2a},\; f\!\left(-\dfrac{b}{2a}\right)\right)\)\((0, c)\)Plot \((0, c)\) and \((-b/a, c)\); draw the vertical axis of symmetry halfway at \(x = -b/(2a)\); evaluate \(f(-b/(2a))\) for the vertex!
2. Factored (Root) Form
\(f(x) = a(x - m)(x - n)\)		\(x\)-intercepts (roots) \((m, 0)\) and \((n, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis (\(y = 0\)).\(x = \dfrac{m + n}{2}\)\(\left(\dfrac{m+n}{2},\; -a\!\left(\dfrac{m-n}{2}\right)^2\right)\)\((0, amn)\)Plot the two roots \((m, 0)\) and \((n, 0)\); average them to get \(x_v = (m+n)/2\); plug \(x_v\) into \(f(x)\) to plot the vertex and \((0, amn)\).
3. Vertex Form
\(f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k\)		Vertex \((h, k)\) (extreme value \(k\) at \(x = h\)).\(x = h\)\((h, k)\)\((0, ah^2 + k)\)Plot the vertex \((h, k)\) first; then use the \(1a, 3a\) step rule: step \(\pm 1\) horizontally and \(+a\) vertically to \((h \pm 1, k + a)\), then \(\pm 2\) horizontally and \(+4a\) vertically to \((h \pm 2, k + 4a)\).
4. Shifted-Chord Form
\(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\)		Two symmetric points \((p, l)\) and \((q, l)\) where the parabola crosses the horizontal line \(y = l\)!\(x = \dfrac{p + q}{2}\)\(\left(\dfrac{p+q}{2},\; l - a\!\left(\dfrac{p-q}{2}\right)^2\right)\)\((0, apq + l)\)Draw the horizontal line \(y = l\) and plot \((p, l)\) and \((q, l)\) (since \(f(p) = f(q) = l\)); the vertex sits at the midpoint \(x_v = (p+q)/2\) with height \(y_v = f(x_v)\)!

Why Form 4 \(\big(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\big)\) Is a Top Digital SAT Shortcut: Notice that Form 1 and Form 2 are both special cases of Form 4! Setting \(l = 0\) gives Factored Form \(a(x-m)(x-n)\) (chord along \(y = 0\)), while factoring the first two terms of Standard Form \(ax^2 + bx + c = ax\big(x - (-b/a)\big) + c\) is a chord at \(y = c\) with \(p = 0, q = -b/a\). Whenever an SAT table gives two inputs with the same output \(f(p) = f(q) = l\), write \(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\) immediately!
body.ar:
Every quadratic القطع المكافئ \(y = f(x)\) with leading المعامل \(a \neq 0\) (\(a > 0\) opens upward \(\cup\); \(a < 0\) opens downward \(\cap\)) can be expressed in four powerful SAT forms. Each form displays a different pair of symmetric anchor points directly in its constants:

Quadratic FormWhat Constants Reveal DirectlyAxis of SymmetryVertex \((x_v, y_v)\)\(y\)-InterceptHow to Quickly التمثيل البياني (Step-by-Step)
1. Standard Form
\(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\)		\(y\)-المقطع \((0, c)\) and symmetric partner \(\left(-\dfrac{b}{a},\; c\right)\) at height \(y = c\).\(x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}\)\(\left(-\dfrac{b}{2a},\; f\!\left(-\dfrac{b}{2a}\right)\right)\)\((0, c)\)Plot \((0, c)\) and \((-b/a, c)\); draw the vertical axis of symmetry halfway at \(x = -b/(2a)\); احسب قيمة \(f(-b/(2a))\) for the الرأس!
2. Factored (Root) Form
\(f(x) = a(x - m)(x - n)\)		\(x\)-intercepts (roots) \((m, 0)\) and \((n, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis (\(y = 0\)).\(x = \dfrac{m + n}{2}\)\(\left(\dfrac{m+n}{2},\; -a\!\left(\dfrac{m-n}{2}\right)^2\right)\)\((0, amn)\)Plot the two roots \((m, 0)\) and \((n, 0)\); average them to get \(x_v = (m+n)/2\); plug \(x_v\) into \(f(x)\) to plot the الرأس and \((0, amn)\).
3. الرأس Form
\(f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k\)		Vertex \((h, k)\) (extreme value \(k\) at \(x = h\)).\(x = h\)\((h, k)\)\((0, ah^2 + k)\)Plot the الرأس \((h, k)\) first; then use the \(1a, 3a\) step rule: step \(\pm 1\) horizontally and \(+a\) vertically to \((h \pm 1, k + a)\), then \(\pm 2\) horizontally and \(+4a\) vertically to \((h \pm 2, k + 4a)\).
4. Shifted-Chord Form
\(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\)		Two symmetric points \((p, l)\) and \((q, l)\) حيث the القطع المكافئ crosses the horizontal line \(y = l\)!\(x = \dfrac{p + q}{2}\)\(\left(\dfrac{p+q}{2},\; l - a\!\left(\dfrac{p-q}{2}\right)^2\right)\)\((0, apq + l)\)Draw the horizontal line \(y = l\) and plot \((p, l)\) and \((q, l)\) (since \(f(p) = f(q) = l\)); the الرأس sits at the midpoint \(x_v = (p+q)/2\) with height \(y_v = f(x_v)\)!

Why Form 4 \(\big(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\big)\) Is a Top Digital SAT Shortcut: Notice that Form 1 and Form 2 are both special cases of Form 4! Setting \(l = 0\) gives Factored Form \(a(x-m)(x-n)\) (chord along \(y = 0\)), while factoring the first two terms of Standard Form \(ax^2 + bx + c = ax\big(x - (-b/a)\big) + c\) is a chord at \(y = c\) with \(p = 0, q = -b/a\). Whenever an SAT الجدول gives two inputs with the same output \(f(p) = f(q) = l\), write \(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\) immediately!

title.en: Form 1 · Standard Form: \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) (Example: \(f(x) = x^{2} -4x + 3\))

caption.en: In Standard Form \(f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3\) (\(a=1, b=-4, c=3\)), the constant \(c = 3\) gives the \(y\)-intercept \((0, 3)\) and its symmetric partner \((-b/a, c) = (4, 3)\). The axis of symmetry is halfway at \(x = -b/(2a) = 2\), giving vertex \((2, f(2)) = (2, -1)\).
caption.ar: تمثيل بياني إحداثي يوضح سلوك الدالة والخصائص التحليلية المحورية في العبارات المتكافئة والمعادلات والدوال التربيعية.

title.en: Form 2 · Factored (Root) Form: \(f(x) = a(x - m)(x - n)\) (Example: \(f(x) = (x - 1)(x - 5)\))

caption.en: In Factored Form \(f(x) = (x - 1)(x - 5)\), the roots \((m, 0) = (1, 0)\) and \((n, 0) = (5, 0)\) are read directly. Their midpoint gives the axis of symmetry \(x = (1 + 5)/2 = 3\), and plugging in \(x = 3\) yields vertex \((3, (3-1)(3-5)) = (3, -4)\).
caption.ar: تمثيل بياني إحداثي يوضح سلوك الدالة والخصائص التحليلية المحورية في العبارات المتكافئة والمعادلات والدوال التربيعية.

title.en: Form 3 · Vertex Form: \(f(x) = a(x - h)^{2} + k\) (Example: \(f(x) = (x - 2)^{2} - 3\))

caption.en: In Vertex Form \(f(x) = (x - 2)^2 - 3\), start directly at the vertex \((h, k) = (2, -3)\). Moving \(\pm 1\) horizontally steps up by \(1a = 1\) to \((1, -2)\) and \((3, -2)\); moving \(\pm 2\) horizontally steps up by \(4a = 4\) to \((0, 1)\) and \((4, 1)\).
caption.ar: تمثيل بياني إحداثي يوضح سلوك الدالة والخصائص التحليلية المحورية في العبارات المتكافئة والمعادلات والدوال التربيعية.

title.en: Form 4 · Shifted-Chord Form: \(f(x) = a(x - p)(x - q) + l\) (Example: \(f(x) = (x - 1)(x - 5) + 2\))

caption.en: In Shifted-Chord Form \(f(x) = (x - 1)(x - 5) + 2\), setting \(x = 1\) or \(x = 5\) makes the product zero, so \(f(1) = 2\) and \(f(5) = 2\)! Plot the chord points \((1, 2)\) and \((5, 2)\) on the line \(y = l = 2\); their midpoint \(x = 3\) gives the vertex \((3, (3-1)(3-5)+2) = (3, -2)\).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic المعادلات)

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Vieta's Root Relations Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all real \(x\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\). Furthermore, matching \(ax^2 + bx + c = a(x - r_1)(x - r_2) = ax^2 - a(r_1 + r_2)x + ar_1r_2\) immediately proves that the sum of the solutions is \(r_1 + r_2 = -\frac{b}{a}\) and the product of the solutions is \(r_1 r_2 = \frac{c}{a}\).
body.ar:
Why Completing the Square & Vieta's Root Relations Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all real \(x\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\). Furthermore, matching \(ax^2 + bx + c = a(x - r_1)(x - r_2) = ax^2 - a(r_1 + r_2)x + ar_1r_2\) immediately proves that the sum of the الحلول is \(r_1 + r_2 = -\frac{b}{a}\) and the product of the الحلول is \(r_1 r_2 = \frac{c}{a}\).

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

What are all real solutions to the quadratic equation \( 2x^2 + 7x - 15 = 0 \)?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): Level 1 · Foundations

What are all real solutions to the quadratic equation \( 2x^2 + 7x - 15 = 0 \)?

solution.en:
Factor by grouping (find two numbers whose product is \( 2(-15) = -30 \) and sum is 7: 10 and -3):

\[ 2x^2 + 10x - 3x - 15 = 0 \implies 2x(x + 5) - 3(x + 5) = 0 \implies (2x - 3)(x + 5) = 0. \]\[ x = \frac{3}{2} \quad\text{or}\quad x = -5. \]
solution.ar:
حلّل by grouping (أوجد two numbers whose product is \( 2(-15) = -30 \) and sum is 7: 10 and -3):

\[ 2x^2 + 10x - 3x - 15 = 0 \implies 2x(x + 5) - 3(x + 5) = 0 \implies (2x - 3)(x + 5) = 0. \]\[ x = \frac{3}{2} \quad\text{or}\quad x = -5. \]

body.en: Convert standard form to vertex form \( y = a(x - h)^2 + k \), identify maximum/minimum values, and apply Vieta's shortcuts.
body.ar: Convert standard form to الرأس form \( y = a(x - h)^2 + k \), identify maximum/minimum values, and apply Vieta's shortcuts.

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Quadratics & Vertex Form
label.ar: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Quadratics & الرأس Form

body.en:
• Minimum/Maximum Value Trap: When asked for the minimum or maximum value of a quadratic, the answer is the \(y\)-coordinate of the vertex (\(k\)), NOT the \(x\)-value (\(h\)) where it occurs.
  • Vieta's Formula Shortcuts: For \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\), the sum of roots is \(-b/a\) and the product of roots is \(c/a\). Memorizing these saves minutes over factoring or using the quadratic formula!
  • Discriminant Zero / Tangency: 'Exactly one real solution' or 'intersects at exactly one point' means \(b^2 - 4ac = 0\). 'No real solutions' means b^2 - 4ac < 0.
  • Vertex Form Signs: In \(y = a(x - h)^2 + k\), the vertex is \((h, k)\). For \(y = 3(x + 5)^2 - 4\), the vertex is \((-5, -4)\), NOT \((+5, -4)\).
body.ar:
• Minimum/Maximum Value Trap: عندما asked for the minimum or maximum value of a quadratic, the الإجابة is the \(y\)-الإحداثي of the الرأس (\(k\)), NOT the \(x\)-value (\(h\)) حيث it occurs.
  • Vieta's الصيغة Shortcuts: For \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\), the sum of roots is \(-b/a\) and the product of roots is \(c/a\). Memorizing these saves minutes over factoring or using the quadratic الصيغة!
  • Discriminant Zero / Tangency: 'Exactly one real الحل' or 'intersects at exactly one point' means \(b^2 - 4ac = 0\). 'No real الحلول' means b^2 - 4ac < 0.
  • Vertex Form Signs: In \(y = a(x - h)^2 + k\), the الرأس is \((h, k)\). For \(y = 3(x + 5)^2 - 4\), the الرأس is \((-5, -4)\), NOT \((+5, -4)\).

body.en:
Find the vertex and state the minimum value of \( y = (x - 3)^2 + 2 \).

In vertex form \( y = a(x - h)^2 + k \), the vertex is \( (h, k) = (3, 2) \). Since a = 1 > 0 , the parabola opens upward and the minimum value of the function is \( y = 2 \).
body.ar:
Find the الرأس and state the minimum value of \( y = (x - 3)^2 + 2 \).

In الرأس form \( y = a(x - h)^2 + k \), the الرأس is \( (h, k) = (3, 2) \). Since a = 1 > 0 , the القطع المكافئ opens upward and the minimum value of the الدالة is \( y = 2 \).

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

What is the sum of the solutions to \( 3x^2 - 18x + 7 = 0 \), and what is the minimum value of \( f(x) = 3x^2 - 18x + 7 \)?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): Level 2 · Medium

What is the sum of the solutions to \( 3x^2 - 18x + 7 = 0 \), and what is the minimum value of \( f(x) = 3x^2 - 18x + 7 \)?

solution.en:
1. Sum of solutions: By Vieta's formulas, \(\text{Sum} = -\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{-18}{3} = 6\).
  2. Minimum value: The vertex \(x\)-coordinate is \(h = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{-18}{2(3)} = 3\). The minimum value is \(f(3) = 3(3)^2 - 18(3) + 7 = 27 - 54 + 7 = -20\).
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية:
  1. Sum of solutions: By Vieta's formulas, \(\text{Sum} = -\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{-18}{3} = 6\).
  2. Minimum value: The vertex \(x\)-coordinate is \(h = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{-18}{2(3)} = 3\). The minimum value is \(f(3) = 3(3)^2 - 18(3) + 7 = 27 - 54 + 7 = -20\).

تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(x\) ، \(h = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{-18}{2(3)}\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

body.en: Solve nonlinear systems of equations, set up discriminant conditions for tangency (one intersection), and evaluate absolute value quadratics.
body.ar: Solve nonlinear systems of المعادلات, set up discriminant conditions for tangency (one التقاطع), and احسب قيمة absolute value quadratics.

body.en:
Find all intersections of \(y=x^{2}\) and \(y=x+2\).

Set equal: \(x^{2}=x+2\Rightarrow x^{2}-x-2=0\Rightarrow(x-2)(x+1)=0\).

\[x=2,\;y=4\qquad\text{and}\qquad x=-1,\;y=1.\]
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (العبارات المتكافئة والمعادلات والدوال التربيعية):

Find all intersections of \(y=x^{2}\) and \(y=x+2\).

Set equal: \(x^{2}=x+2\Rightarrow x^{2}-x-2=0\Rightarrow(x-2)(x+1)=0\).

\[x=2,\;y=4\qquad\text{and}\qquad x=-1,\;y=1.\]

body.en:
Find all points of intersection between \( y = x^2 \) and \( y = x + 2 \).

Set equal: \( x^2 = x + 2 \implies x^2 - x - 2 = 0 \implies (x - 2)(x + 1) = 0 \).

\[ x = 2 \implies y = 4 \quad\text{and}\quad x = -1 \implies y = 1. \]

The intersection points are \( (2, 4) \) and \( (-1, 1) \).
body.ar:
Find all points of التقاطع between \( y = x^2 \) and \( y = x + 2 \).

Set equal: \( x^2 = x + 2 \implies x^2 - x - 2 = 0 \implies (x - 2)(x + 1) = 0 \).

\[ x = 2 \implies y = 4 \quad\text{and}\quad x = -1 \implies y = 1. \]

The التقاطع points are \( (2, 4) \) and \( (-1, 1) \).

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

How many real solutions does the system of equations \( y = x^2 - 4x + 4 \) and \( y = 2x - 3 \) have?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): Level 3 · Advanced

How many real solutions does the system of equations \( y = x^2 - 4x + 4 \) and \( y = 2x - 3 \) have?

solution.en:
Substitute the linear expression into the quadratic:

\[ x^2 - 4x + 4 = 2x - 3 \implies x^2 - 6x + 7 = 0. \]

Compute the discriminant \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \):

\[ \Delta = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(7) = 36 - 28 = 8. \]

Since \Delta > 0 , the quadratic has two distinct real roots. Thus, the system has two real solutions.
solution.ar:
عوّض the linear expression into the quadratic:

\[ x^2 - 4x + 4 = 2x - 3 \implies x^2 - 6x + 7 = 0. \]

Compute the discriminant \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \):

\[ \Delta = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(7) = 36 - 28 = 8. \]

Since \Delta > 0 , the quadratic has two distinct real roots. وعليه، the system has two real solutions.

question.en:
Level 4 · Synthesis

The line \( y = 2x + c \) is tangent to the parabola \( y = x^2 - 6x + 7 \) at exactly one point in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the value of the constant \( c \)?
question.ar:
Level 4 · Synthesis

The line \( y = 2x + c \) is tangent to the parabola \( y = x^2 - 6x + 7 \) at exactly one point in the \( xy \)-plane. ما قيمة the constant \( c \)?

solution.en:
Set the equations equal to each other:

\[ x^2 - 6x + 7 = 2x + c \implies x^2 - 8x + (7 - c) = 0. \]

For tangency (exactly one real solution), the discriminant must equal zero:

\[ \Delta = (-8)^2 - 4(1)(7 - c) = 0 \implies 64 - 28 + 4c = 0 \implies 4c = -36 \implies c = -9. \]
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية:

Set the equations equal to each other:

\[ x^2 - 6x + 7 = 2x + c \implies x^2 - 8x + (7 - c) = 0. \]

For tangency (exactly one real solution), the discriminant must equal zero:

\[ \Delta = (-8)^2 - 4(1)(7 - c) = 0 \implies 64 - 28 + 4c = 0 \implies 4c = -36 \implies c = -9. \]

question.en: Which value of \( x \) satisfies \( x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 \)?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): Which value of \( x \) satisfies \( x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 \)?

hints.en: Rearrange the terms in \((x-2)(x-3)=0\) to isolate \(x\). Compute the value of \(x\) and check that it satisfies \((x-2)(x-3)=0\).
hints.ar: أعد ترتيب الحدود في \((x-2)(x-3)=0\) لعزل المتغير \(x\). احسب قيمة \(x\) وتحقق من أنها تحقق المعادلة \((x-2)(x-3)=0\).

solution.ar: خطوات الحل التفصيلية: \( (x-2)(x-3)=0 \Rightarrow x=2 \) or \( x=3 \). Choice: \( x=2 \).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
